title: Riverbend Patient Financial Services Policy: Signing the Patient Payment Plan Agreement
content:
**1. Personal signature.** A **Patient Payment Plan** starts only when the patient personally signs the agreement form, the Riverbend Patient Payment Plan Agreement (PFS-210). A representative may set the plan up and send the agreement but can never sign or accept it for the patient.

**2. Signature deadline.** The patient must sign no later than the signature deadline counted from the date the plan was offered. The clock starts from the plan's offered date as shown on the plan record. Count calendar days starting the day after the offered date; a signature on the last day of the deadline is accepted. The deadline length is the tier's signature deadline.

**3. Down payment.** The clause "Any down payment is paid at signing." is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis.

**4. Lapse.** A plan not signed by the deadline lapses to cancelled and the balances stay on standard statements.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical, 14-day deadline)

| Offered on | Signed on | Day count from the day after the offer | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| the 1st of a month | the 15th of that month | 14 — the last day of the deadline | accepted |
| the 1st of a month | the 16th of that month | 15 — after the deadline | not accepted; the plan lapses to cancelled |

On a 21-day deadline the same offer date makes the 22nd the last day on which a signature is accepted.

superseded_clauses: Any down payment is paid at signing.
